name: production boundary: a push whose GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS carries push.followTags is denied as a push off the run branch

source.assertion:
assert_equals "a push whose GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS carries push.followTags is denied as a push off the run branch" \
  "deny" "$(verdict_for "GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS=\"'push.followTags'='true'\" git push origin oso-run/x")"

contains: it pushes its own oso-run/* branch and nothing else
